discovery_notes: Follow-up to packet 242 (b108); reuses its keys. Holds released: Neo Nouveau S3 (Pulse per-design listings), Neo Nouveau S2 jasmine/elsa only, Princess & Horse S2 and S3 (per-pin entries in DPB posts), Rescuers edition mapping (250/125). Pixar mystery holds kept. New 2021-2022 releases found: Lion King LE 200, Pinocchio (Aug 2021), Kim Possible, Ariel/Belle/Jasmine/Rapunzel LE, Cute Dumbo, Pastel (held), Coco, Floral S1/S2 (partly held), Pooh, Moana, Jasmine & Rapunzel Window (held). Princess and Swing, BatB Oval, Roger Rabbit are 2025+ (out of window). MyPinCentral 68065 Pocahontas LE 300 seen but not tied to ArtLand; not used. 30 searches.
